request: The CRM should alert us when our relationship with a country goes cold.
executive_summary: This release will implement an alert system that notifies users when engagement with country contacts remains inactive for a specified duration. The system will not include suggestions for relationship-building or integration with external systems at this time. Decision-makers will still need to contend with operational concerns regarding alert management and the risk of alert fatigue as development proceeds.

core_commitments.text: Implement an alert system for detecting inactive relationships with country contacts.
core_commitments.note: The alert system for detecting inactive relationships with country contacts will be built to enhance user awareness of engagement status and improve oversight.

in_scope.text: Define 'cold relationship' as a lack of recorded engagement activities for 90 consecutive days, with an additional requirement that alerts are sent only to users who have authorization to view information regarding that country.
in_scope.note: The definition of 'cold relationship' was clarified to specifically require inactivity for 90 consecutive days, addressing confidentiality concerns regarding alert distribution.

in_scope.text: Allow users to receive alerts via email regarding cold relationships, with protocols in place ensuring that alerts regarding diplomatic contacts are sent exclusively to users with the 'diplomatic_security' role in the CRM, who have clearance to handle sensitive information.
in_scope.note: Protocols for sending alerts concerning sensitive diplomatic contacts were established to ensure only authorized personnel receive them, addressing confidentiality issues.

in_scope.text: Enable users to filter and view a list of contacts with cold relationships in the CRM.
in_scope.note: Users will be able to view a list of contacts with cold relationships, aiding in the management of country engagements and enabling monitoring.

in_scope.text: Provide options for users to set customized thresholds for inactivity alerts, ranging from 30 to 120 days, with the stipulation that valid engagement activities must include documented interactions such as meetings, emails, or official communications logged in the CRM, which will be reviewed monthly for accuracy by the CRM administrator.
in_scope.note: The threshold for engagement activities needed for alerts was specified clearly to mitigate the risk of users setting inappropriate custom values.

in_scope.text: Assign the responsibility for maintaining the alert system, monitoring engagement logs, and adjusting user preferences to the CRM administrator role, who will work with regional coordinators to filter and prioritize alerts based on urgency.
in_scope.note: The responsibility for maintaining the alert system is assigned to the CRM administrator to ensure accountability and effective oversight.

out_of_scope.text: This release will not include relationship-building suggestions based on contacts' engagement history.
This release will not integrate with external systems for engagement history tracking.

assumptions.text: Users have sufficient privileges to set alert preferences and view engagement history; this depends on existing user role management capabilities.
assumptions.note: Assumed user privileges exist for setting alert preferences and accessing engagement history; this will depend on role management capabilities.

assumptions.text: Engagement activities are logged in the CRM; this depends on current CRM functionality for tracking such activities.
assumptions.note: Assumed current CRM functionality allows for effective logging of engagement activities; this is necessary for the alert system to function properly.

assumptions.text: Users understand what constitutes a "cold relationship" based on the defined thresholds; this assumes adequate training and documentation is provided.
assumptions.note: Users are expected to understand the concept of a 'cold relationship,' depending on training and clear documentation being provided.

definitions.text: "cold relationship" means a lack of recorded engagement activities with a country contact for 90 consecutive days.
definitions.note: 'Cold relationship' is clearly defined to ensure users know when engagement activity is deemed inactive, aiding in system clarity.

definitions.text: "engagement activities" means any logged interaction or correspondence with a country contact, such as meetings, emails, or calls.
definitions.note: Engagement activities are defined to include logged interactions that allow transparency and functionality within the alert system.

success_criteria.text: Achieve at least a 75% user satisfaction rate with the new alert system, measured through user surveys within one month of release.
success_criteria.note: A user satisfaction rate of at least 75% is targeted post-release to gauge the effectiveness and acceptance of the alert system.

open_questions.question: What strategies will be implemented to manage the potential for alert fatigue arising from numerous cold relationship notifications?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Identifying ways to effectively manage alert volume is crucial to ensure that important alerts aren't overlooked.
options: Offer more granular alert customization options
Incorporate monitoring tools for alert frequency

tension.summary: The primary disagreement centered around managing potential alert fatigue and ensuring the effectiveness of the notifications. While the Proposer believes user customization options may be sufficient, the Critic insists that the risk of irrelevant alerts overwhelms significant notifications, leaving this concern unresolved.

proposer.worry: The potential for inaccurate logging of engagement activities leading to premature alerts still remains a concern.

critic.worry: The risk of alert fatigue remains significant, as user customization alone may not be sufficient to prevent irrelevant alerts from overwhelming important notifications.

issues.failure_scenario: A false alert is sent about a cold relationship to an unauthorized user, leading to potential diplomatic issues.
issues.resolution_test: What safeguards are in place to ensure sensitive diplomatic contacts remain confidential and alert notifications only reach authorized personnel?
